goal: Production-ready, product-neutral infrastructure MCP services plus safe agent/n8n reference orchestration.
execution_rule: At every run re-read current main, open PRs/issues/CI and preserve parallel work before taking the next non-blocked work item.

standard_read_only.audit: actor, reason/source and correlation ID; credentials and unrestricted raw payloads excluded

agent_optimized_diagnostics.server_load_protection: reject over-broad work before dispatch and oversized responses before parsing

required_controls: approval bound to exact target and desired state
